title: Debt terms (1): yield and duration
objectives: Explain coupon, YTM and average maturity in plain words.
Say how modified duration predicts a price move for a 1% rate change.
body_md:
Many investors treat debt funds like fixed deposits. They are not: their value moves with interest rates and with the credit quality of what they hold. Coupon is the fixed interest a bond pays on face value. YTM (Yield to Maturity) is the return the fund's current bonds would earn if held to maturity, before expenses — a guide, not a promise. Average maturity is the average time until the fund's bonds are repaid; Macaulay duration is the weighted-average time to receive cash flows; modified duration is how much price changes for a 1% rate change. Interest-rate risk is the core debt risk: bond prices fall when rates rise.

| Term | Plain meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Coupon | The fixed interest a bond pays on its face value | ₹1,000 bond with 7% coupon pays ₹70 a year |
| YTM (Yield to Maturity) | The return the fund's current bonds would earn if held to maturity, before expenses. A guide, not a promise | Fund YTM 7.4%, TER 0.4% → roughly 7% indicative, if nothing changes |
| Average maturity | Average time until the fund's bonds are repaid | Liquid fund: up to 91 days; gilt fund: often 10+ years |
| Macaulay duration | The weighted average time to receive a bond's cash flows, in years | Used to match a fund to a goal date |
| Modified duration | How much the fund's price changes for a 1% change in interest rates | Modified duration 4 → rates up 1% ≈ price down 4% |
| Interest-rate risk | Bond prices fall when rates rise, and rise when rates fall. Longer duration = bigger effect | Gilt funds swing more than liquid funds |

> **Investor takeaway:** For short-term goals, choose low duration and high credit quality. Never chase the highest yield without asking why it is high.
example: Modified duration 4: rates up 1% means price down about 4%. A fund with YTM 7.4% and TER 0.4% is roughly 7% indicative, if nothing changes.
say: YTM is today's indicative yield, not a promise.
For short goals: low duration, high credit quality.
never: A debt fund is as safe as an FD.
The highest yield is always the best debt fund.

check.q: A debt fund with modified duration 5 will, if rates rise 1%, roughly:
check.why: Lose 5%. Modified duration × rate change ≈ price change.
